csv_project_name: Design for Student Success & CM Programs Renovations
csv_agency: Board of Regents University System of Georgia
csv_scope_of_work: The Board of Regents of the University System of Georgia ( BOR ) as ( Owner ), on behalf of Kennesaw State University ( KSU ), ( User ) is soliciting statements of Qualifications from firms interested in providing design professional services for the construction of a project known as Project No. J-467, Renovations for Student Success and Construction Management Programs at Kennesaw State University, Marietta, Georgia. The project will encompass renovations of the Administration Building and Clair Harris Building located on the Marietta Campus. The Administration Building renovation will transform the facility into a centralized Student Success Hub serving student-facing departments and programs, including Student Success, International Student Services, advising and support functions, collaborative spaces, student engagement areas, meeting rooms, offices, and associated support spaces. The project is intended to create a welcoming and highly functional environment that enhances the student experience and consolidates services currently located in multiple buildings across campus. The design team shall utilize the completed feasibility study and programming report as the basis for design development and final construction documents. This report shall be shared with the shortlisted firms. The Clair Harris Building renovation will consist of an interior modernization and refresh of existing occupied spaces. Scope will include replacement and upgrading of interior finishes, lighting, ceilings, flooring, accessibility improvements, minor reconfiguration of spaces, selective demolition, and evaluation and replacement or modification of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems as required to support the renovated spaces.
